messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

It sounds like copper is your main cost pressure, yet you prefer a fixed price rather than an automatic adjustment mechanism. We want to preserve our longstanding partnership on a basis that recognises genuine cost increases and the financing cost of payment timing. How can we balance price and payment timing so the agreement remains sustainable for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge the confirmed volume and positive demand forecast, which allows us to adjust our pricing.
Please note that extending payment terms to 90 days incurs substantial financing costs that would necessitate a higher unit price.
To provide you with the most competitive rate, we propose maintaining the 30-day payment term at a revised price of €369.76 per unit.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised proposal and your commitment to our long-standing partnership. 

Our offer stands at a price of €373.26 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

The financing costs associated with 90-day payment terms are substantial and must be directly reflected in the unit price. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

To move forward, we can offer a revised price of €372.64 per unit for the 90-day payment term. Under our Angebot, the full terms are a price of €372.64 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
